title: Bryant Furnace Code 13: Limit or rollout circuit lockout
meaning: The limit or flame-rollout circuit opened repeatedly and the furnace locked out.
commonCauses: A blocked flue or combustion-air path
A damaged or restricted heat exchanger
whenToCallPro: Leave the furnace off and call a licensed technician for a combustion-safety inspection.
dangerNote: Keep the furnace off. Do not reset a rollout switch. If you smell gas or a carbon-monoxide alarm sounds, leave the building and contact emergency services or the gas utility.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 13 means the limit or flame-rollout circuit opened repeatedly and the furnace locked out on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Carrier-family two-stage controls covered by troubleshooting guide 58-3T.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 14: Ignition lockout
meaning: The furnace failed to ignite or prove flame in four attempts and entered ignition lockout.
commonCauses: A dirty or weak flame sensor
diySteps: Confirm the thermostat is calling for heat and the gas shutoff has not been moved.
Turn furnace power off for five minutes, restore it once, and note whether the same code returns.
whenToCallPro: Call a licensed technician if ignition fails again after one reset or if you smell gas.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 14 means the furnace failed to ignite or prove flame in four attempts and entered ignition lockout on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Carrier-family two-stage controls covered by troubleshooting guide 58-3T.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 15: Blower Motor Lockout
meaning: The blower motor exceeded safe current draw or failed to start properly.
diySteps: Turn off power.
Spin the blower wheel by hand to check for binding.
Do not force a stuck motor.
whenToCallPro: Blower motor lockouts typically require motor or capacitor replacement.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 15 means blower motor exceeded safe current draw or failed to start properly. Most often from seized blower wheel. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $450–$1200.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 23: Pressure switch was closed at the wrong time
meaning: The low-heat pressure switch did not open when the heat call began.
commonCauses: A pinched or incorrectly connected pressure hose
Shorted pressure-switch wiring or a control fault
diySteps: Turn furnace power off for five minutes and do not bypass or jumper the pressure switch.
Check only the outdoor vent openings for obvious snow, ice, leaves, or nests before restoring power once.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if the code returns; the switch, hose, wiring, and inducer draft need testing.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 23 means the low-heat pressure switch did not open when the heat call began on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Carrier-family two-stage controls covered by troubleshooting guide 58-3T.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 24: Low-voltage fuse is open
meaning: The secondary-voltage fuse is open because of a low-voltage short.
diySteps: Turn furnace power off and check for an obviously pinched thermostat wire without touching board terminals.
Do not install a larger fuse or repeatedly replace a fuse that opens again.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician to locate the low-voltage short before replacing the fuse again.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 24 means the secondary-voltage fuse is open because of a low-voltage short on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Carrier-family two-stage controls covered by troubleshooting guide 58-3T.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 31: Pressure-switch circuit did not close
meaning: The high-heat pressure switch or relay did not close, or reopened during operation.
commonCauses: A blocked intake or exhaust vent
A restricted condensate drain or pressure hose
A weak inducer motor or pressure switch
diySteps: With the furnace off, check outdoor intake and exhaust openings for snow, ice, leaves, or nests.
Replace a visibly dirty air filter, restore power once, and note whether the code returns.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if the vent is clear and the pressure-switch code returns; combustion-air testing requires instruments.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 31 means the high-heat pressure switch or relay did not close, or reopened during operation on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Carrier-family two-stage controls covered by troubleshooting guide 58-3T.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 34: Ignition-proving fault
meaning: The control did not sense flame during ignition, or lost the flame signal while running.
commonCauses: A dirty or weak flame sensor
Unstable gas pressure or burner flame
diySteps: Confirm the gas shutoff has not been moved and the furnace panel is fully seated.
Try one reset and watch whether the burners light and then shut off again.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if flame drops out again or ignition becomes delayed or noisy.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 34 means the control did not sense flame during ignition, or lost the flame signal while running on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 41: Blower Motor Fault
meaning: The control detected an error in the blower motor or its speed tap circuit.
diySteps: Turn off power.
Check that the blower door panel is secure.
Inspect the motor plug connection.
whenToCallPro: Blower faults usually require motor or board replacement.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 41 means control detected an error in the blower motor or its speed tap circuit. Most often from failed blower motor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $450–$1200.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 42: Inducer Motor Fault
meaning: The inducer motor did not respond correctly during the pre-purge cycle.
diySteps: Inspect the vent outlet.
Listen for inducer hum without rotation.
Clear any visible blockages.
whenToCallPro: Inducer motor replacement is needed if the motor will not start.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 42 means inducer motor did not respond correctly during the pre-purge cycle. Most often from seized inducer. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $400–$900.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

Check for debris in the blower wheel.
Spin the wheel to feel for binding.

snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 44 means blower drew more current than the control board allows. Most often from restricted blower wheel. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $450–$1200.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 45: Control-board fault
meaning: The integrated furnace control detected an internal failure and requires professional diagnosis.
commonCauses: A failed control-board relay or sensing circuit
Electrical surge, moisture, or poor grounding
diySteps: Turn furnace power off for five minutes and restore it once.
If the code returns, leave the furnace off rather than repeatedly resetting the control.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician to test wiring and connected components before replacing the control board.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 45 means the integrated furnace control detected an internal failure and requires professional diagnosis on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 51: Gas Valve Stuck Open
meaning: The control detected gas flow when the valve should have been closed.
whenToCallPro: A stuck-open gas valve is a serious safety issue requiring immediate service.
dangerNote: If you smell gas, leave the house and call your gas utility before anything else.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 51 means control detected gas flow when the valve should have been closed. This is an emergency — do not attempt DIY repairs. Call a licensed technician immediately; typical repairs run $350–$900.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

title: Bryant Furnace Code 53: Flame Not Sensed
meaning: The flame sensor did not prove flame after the gas valve opened.
commonCauses: Weak flame due to low gas
diySteps: Clean the flame sensor.
Verify burners ignite fully.
Reset and observe one complete cycle.
whenToCallPro: If flame is visible but not sensed, replace the flame sensor.
snippetAnswer: Bryant furnace code 53 means flame sensor did not prove flame after the gas valve opened. Most often from dirty flame sensor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$300.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.
